a: PDFs contain pages, fonts, images, and optional text objects or scanned images.
Text-based PDFs extract cleanly; scanned PDFs need OCR.
Tesseract and cloud OCR convert image text to strings.
Libraries like reportlab, pdfkit, or headless Chromium generate PDFs.
Tagged PDFs and alt text improve accessibility.
Compress images, subset fonts, and remove unused objects.
PDF signatures verify integrity and signer identity.
AcroForm fields can be filled programmatically.
Untrusted PDFs can embed scripts; sanitize and open carefully.
DOCX is editable structured XML; PDF is fixed-layout for exchange/print.
